svg.text: nrw agent run · how an unattended session's prompt is composed
One sample, one declared task, one bounded harness session: compose() builds the text from files that already exist, and the limits live outside it
GATES & INPUTS
THE PROMPT (agent/session.py _prompt)
HARNESS & OUTPUT

g.text: one message, on stdin ≈8 KB here
"You are running unattended during a neutron beamtime, analysing
sample `{sample}` in this nr-workbench project. Nobody will answer
a question until morning."
## What the scientist asked for

text.tspan: "This is from `samples/{sample}/sample.md`, and it is the whole
of your task. Do this and nothing else."
with --task-file: that the task was given to this session and takes the place of ## Fits to perform

g.text: ## What the offline checks already found
"Run before you started, from the file headers, the specs and the
recorded fits. Read these before deciding anything …"

text.tspan: {one block per check that had something to say}
never empty: the fit list always says something

g.text: ## Read these first
## Who reads what you write
"From `[audience]` in `nrw.toml`. These change how much you explain
and in what order; they refuse nothing."

text.tspan: the fixed sections, abridged from here on

g.text: - nrw --help is the tool surface; every subcommand has --help
- explore with --method amoeba; re-fit with --method dream before
quoting an uncertainty. Those two are the only fitters.
- a chi-squared that got worse means the last edit was wrong
- one fit at a time; nrw assess after each: no second model is
consulted while you are driving
- say why as you launch it: nrw fit run … --note "…"
- write the rest before the next fit: nrw note <fit> --why --showed
--caveat; nrw ls says how many fits have nothing written
## What you must not do
- nrw promote · nrw isaac export --upload · any --force
"These are refused by a hook, so trying them wastes a turn."
- reach one, or anything you would have asked → append to
ESCALATIONS.md: what, the fit id, the evidence, what you would do
## If work has already been done here
read the report first; do only what is left; disagree with evidence,
never by silently redoing a fit
## When you are done
nrw report {sample} → -technical.md · -si.md · -plain.md, one
analysis at three altitudes; nrw report --check {sample}

--task-file <file>
whoever starts the session wrote it (nr-watcher does)
else ## Fits to perform in sample.md
the scientist's words, never the session's choice
observe() · seven offline checks
_observe_arriving
STILL ARRIVING: changed in the last 300 s, or a series short
_observe_quarantine
DO NOT FIT these runs: inconsistent files
_observe_data
Data vs sample.md (nrw data reconcile)
_observe_specs
Specs as nrw check finds them; abandoned ones
_observe_fits
Recorded fits, oldest first, up to 40
_observe_report
Reports already written, quoted as they are
_observe_missing_skills
skills the notes call for → nrw skills add …
no model in any of them; one that fails is one line,
not a session that fails to start. Fit notes, model names
and reasons are flattened to one line each, and capped.
skills · relevant_skills(notes)
the same word match as nrw model new; only the
paths are listed, and the harness reads the files
audience · [audience] in nrw.toml
how much to explain, and in what order;
unset → defaults, which say nobody has set them
refused before anything runs
the CLI:
· --task-file names an empty file
compose():
· a sample name that is not plain (it builds paths)
· no samples/<id>/sample.md
· no --task-file, and ## Fits to perform empty once its
<!-- guidance --> is stripped
· a written report in reports/ already, and no --again
run(), before the harness starts:
· the project's limit not installed: Claude Code's
PreToolUse hook, or OpenCode's plugin and deny rules
· a session already running on this sample
· a harness with no turn cap, and no --timeout
.nrw/agent/<stamp>-<sample>-prompt.md
written before the harness starts: the record of what the
session was told. --dry-run prints this text and stops.
harness_invocation() · session.py, argv from driver.py
Claude Code, the default
claude -p --max-turns 200 --output-format stream-json
--verbose --permission-mode bypassPermissions [--model M]
the prompt on stdin: named as -p @file, a large prompt never
reached the model (2026-10-04)
OpenCode, --harness opencode
opencode run [--standalone] --format json --auto [--model]
the prompt on stdin; no turn cap, so --timeout is required

svg.text: THE SAME SESSION, STARTED OTHER WAYS
nrw agent watch
Polls until a measurement has settled -- its files unchanged
for the settle window, a series complete -- holds back
quarantined runs, then calls the same session.run().
--max-sessions 1 returns after one.
--task-file
The task is given, not read from sample.md: the
prompt says it takes the place of ## Fits to perform.
nr-watcher plans each sample's task this way.
--again
A second pass over a task that already has a
written report: the prompt's last sections tell it
to read that report and do only what is left.
nrw check-llm --harness
The same command line, --max-turns 1 on Claude Code,
and a one-line probe: "Reply with exactly NRW-OK and
nothing else." One real turn; under NRW_AGENT it
declines rather than start a harness inside one.
